script_text: Unexpected cash flow shakes Taurus this week as Venus in your 2nd House sextiles Jupiter in your 1st, while Mars in Leo squares Saturn in your 11th. Monday through Wednesday bring a Venus‑Jupiter sextile that sweetens income talks and a Mercury ingress into your 3rd House on Wednesday, sharpening negotiations and love chats. The mid‑week pivot arrives Wednesday when Mercury enters Cancer, activating your 3rd House and turning scattered ideas into clear contracts. Thursday through Sunday see the Sun in Gemini sextile Uranus in your 1st House, sparking financial insights. Mars‑Saturn friction on Friday fuels domestic tension and career delays. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury lights your 3rd House for deals and romance. Friday is your danger day as Mars squares Saturn, stalling projects and stirring arguments. Keep Wednesday free for conversations and postpone big purchases until Saturday. Follow for daily updates.
